page_title: LOR 5-0 CLE | Lorient v Clermont 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' A corner kick by Lorient is thwarted by the well prepared Mory Diaw (Clermont).

90+7' A rebound falls at the feet of Formose Mendy (Lorient) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lorient.
90+2' Mory Diaw (Clermont) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+2' The referee points to the corner flag and Lorient will take a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' 5 - 0 Gooal! Bamba Dieng (Lorient) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Mohamed Bamba. He makes it 5:0.
89' 27:9 – the total goal attempt statistics. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 10:4.
85' Lorient can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' The ball falls to Imran Louza (Lorient) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
83' The Lorient players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
82' Today's match ends for Alan Virginius who will be replaced by Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
81' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Yohan Magnin will be replaced by Komnen Andric (Clermont).
78' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Julien Ponceau and he is replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).

75' Lorient concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
73' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
72' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
70' Imran Louza (Lorient) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
69' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) is able to continue to play.
65' The game is interrupted now, Yohan Magnin (Clermont) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) makes a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
63' 4 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Bamba Dieng (Lorient) and he fired home from close range. The score is 4:0.
63' Great chance! Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
61' The ball goes out of play and Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Substitution. Habib Keita (Clermont) replaces Johan Gastien.
59' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ilhan Fakili will be replaced by Florent Ogier (Clermont).
57' It will be a substitution. Imran Louza (Lorient) is ready to enter the pitch as Badredine Bouanani walks off.
56' Here is a change. Aiyegun Tosin is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
56' That's the end of the game for Panos Katseris, who is replaced by Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient).
56' One of the Clermont players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
54' 3 - 0 Goal! Mohamed Bamba tees up Badredine Bouanani (Lorient) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 3:0.
52' Clement Turpin interrupts the game. One of the players from Lorient won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Clermont will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
51' Clermont quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
50' Panos Katseris (Lorient) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+68' Pascal Gastien (Clermont) gets a yellow card.
45+5' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Clermont couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
45+5' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) brings an opponent down and Clement Turpin interrupts the game.
45+3' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Mory Diaw comes off his line to intercept the corner from Badredine Bouanani (Lorient).
42' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Mory Diaw no chance!
42' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is going to take the penalty!
40' Chrislain Matsima (Clermont) makes a strong challenge and Clement Turpin blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Lorient!
39' A player from Lorient commits a rough challenge. Clement Turpin blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

38' 1 - 0 Julien Ponceau passes to Laurent Abergel (Lorient), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 1:0.
37' The ball is out of play. Lorient will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
36' Ilhan Fakili (Clermont) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Yvon Mvogo easily deals with the threat.

34' Alan Virginius (Clermont) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
31' Panos Katseris (Lorient) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
30' Panos Katseris (Lorient) picks up an injury.
27' Ilhan Fakili (Clermont) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yvon Mvogo.

25' CHANCE! Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Neto Borges. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
23' Clement Turpin blows for a foul after Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
20' Benjamin Mendy is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Darlin Yongwa (Lorient).
20' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' Julien Laporte (Lorient) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
19' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Yvon Mvogo.

18' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
17' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call.
17' One of the players from Clermont times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
15' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Clermont is cautioned for aggressive play.
14' Julien Laporte (Lorient) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
14' Clement Turpin interrupts the game. One of the players from Clermont won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

13' Badredine Bouanani sends the free kick into the box. Julien Laporte (Lorient) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
12' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Yohan Magnin (Clermont) for his blatant foul.

8' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
6' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) tackles a bit over-zealously and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
4' Clermont work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

4' Johan Gastien (Clermont) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Clermont are going to take it.
3' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

1' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance. Lorient force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
